name: Dedicate of Ascension
body:
Prerequisite: Knowledge (history) 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): Choose a path of ascension*. Each path of ascension requires a different initial meditation which takes 8 hours. Once you have performed the meditation, you gain the benefit of a special ability or resistance as indicated in the meditation entry for the path of ascension for which you have performed the meditation. If you have at least 12 Hit Dice, you also gain the first boon granted by your path of ascension. If you have at least 16 Hit Dice, you also gain the second boon. If you have 20 Hit Dice or more, you also gain the third boon.

Unless a specific duration or number of uses per day is listed, a boon’s effects are constant. If you have levels in the ascendant vanguard prestige class, you gain access to these boons at lower levels as a benefit of your prestige class.
